items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay concept screenshot for an article about Eoul, a bright Korean folklore game world.
Primary request: Create a clear playable TOP-DOWN 16-bit pixel-art scene of a social-deduction party game in a traditional Korean hanok festival courtyard. Humans and friendly dokkaebi are neighbors playing a harmless masked-festival bluffing game. Discussion, public alibis and a VOTE are the main activity.
Scene and spatial composition: Traditional Korean hanok wooden eaves, stone courtyard, lanterns, colored festival streamers, simple round wooden council table in the upper-middle. EXACTLY SIX masked guest sprite characters stand or sit around that round table, no additional people anywhere in the environment. Several humans in practical hanbok and several friendly Korean dokkaebi, all wearing festival masks. Each guest has a clearly distinct costume color AND a small numbered badge: 1,2,3,4,5,6, used once each. Do not hide the six physical sprites behind the HUD. Six characters should be readable and countable. A separate small lantern station is visible behind the group.
Interface: The top central small HUD reads EXACTLY "DISCUSS 00:45". A compact vote window occupies the lower-middle, clear of the six world sprites. It contains EXACTLY SIX small portrait tiles in TWO ROWS and THREE COLUMNS. Portraits match the six guests' costume colors and are numbered 1,2,3 across the first row and 4,5,6 across the second row. A blank circular vote token appears in each tile. This is a normal UI voting grid, not a separate game board. Below that panel one compact button reads EXACTLY "VOTE". At right a modest alibi/evidence board shows only THREE simple station icons: lantern, bell, drum, connected by a dotted route. A tiny clock icon can indicate chronology. No dense text, no claims of a real implemented game.
Visual style: authentic crisp square 16-bit pixel art; tiled terrain; small distinct sprite characters; restricted harmonious palette, warm lantern amber with cream and jade Korean architecture; friendly dusk festival atmosphere. Camera is a 2D top-down tile-game camera. No 3D, no realistic render, no blur or painterly brushstrokes. Opaque full-bleed landscape image, target composition 1536x864.
Avoid: no corpse, no violence, no blood, no combat, no weapons, no murder theme, no cards, no large title, no watermark, no promotional poster composition. The main readable action must be six people discussing, comparing routes and voting in a harmless folklore festival game.
visual_qa: 생성 원본 확인: 탁자 주위 등장인물 정확히6명, 각각1~6번호와 서로 다른 옷색
items.processing: RGB conversion, nearest-neighbor resize1536x864, WebP quality90 method6; no retouch or compositing.
items.final_visual_review: view_image(original detail)로 최종1536×864RGB WebP 재열람: 구도·등장인물 수·도구·HUD 유지 확인.

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 2D pixel-art gameplay concept screenshot for a manual cleaning and restoration simulator in Eoul, a bright fictional Korean folklore world.
Primary request: A close-up interactive FRONT VIEW of ONE large traditional Korean painted wooden guardian gate in a quiet artisan courtyard. The player manually removes soot and mud using a soft brush, gradually revealing a beautiful gold-armored protective guardian painting on the gate. The central screen must visibly read as a cleaning-work game with a brush cursor and tool HUD.
Scene: One large single painted wooden gate occupies almost the whole playable screen. Korean wood joinery and restrained dancheong painted frame, stone ground, small surrounding courtyard details. Across this same continuous gate surface, the left and upper-left region still has irregular dark soot and dried mud, while approximately the right two-thirds has been cleaned, revealing warm vermilion, teal, cream and GOLD ARMORED GUARDIAN artwork painted ON THE WOOD. It is ONE continuous surface with a natural ragged partially cleaned boundary, not a left-versus-right before/after comparison, not two separate screenshots. A circular soft-brush cursor rests at that dirty-clean boundary near center-left. Show an irregular small fresh clean patch following the brush stroke and a subtle dab of damp bristles, so manual cursor motion feels causal and satisfying. Guardian is a friendly stylized painted folklore protector, not an actual creature emerging from the door. No combat.
HUD: Compact top progress label EXACTLY "CLEAN 68%" with a small slim progress bar. A neat side toolbar contains exactly THREE tool icons: soft round brush, wide folded cloth, single soaking-water drop. The soft brush icon is clearly selected with a cyan outline. Below, a small painted-wood material icon and a compact THREE-ROW part-cleaning checklist with tiny gate part icons and square completion indicators. Keep all HUD inside image margins, away from key artwork. A plain water bucket, folded cloth and brush rest naturally on the ground at the bottom foreground. Minimal English text plus symbols only, no long paragraphs.
Style: authentic readable hand-placed 16-bit pixel art, crisp square pixels, limited harmonious palette, beautiful wooden painted texture constructed from pixels, small tactile cleaning details. Flat interactive front-view 2D game composition, not isometric, not 3D, no realistic photographs, no painterly smooth gradients, no blur. Opaque full-bleed landscape, target composition 1536x864.
Constraints: Manual brush stroke and gradually revealed painting are the central action. No modern pressure washer is required; this is a fictional traditional artisan's workshop. No shop queue, no cash/revenue meter, no inventory packing puzzle, no logic puzzle grid, no diagnosis flowchart, no cards, no large title, no watermark, no promotional poster. The colored guardian painting must be readable enough for the player to want to finish cleaning it.
items.processing: RGB conversion, nearest-neighbor resize1536x864, WebP quality90 method6; no retouch or compositing.
